title: TikTok Transcript Scraper input

videoUrls.title: TikTok video URLs
videoUrls.description: One link per line: https://www.tiktok.com/@user/video/123…, vm.tiktok.com / vt.tiktok.com short links, or bare video IDs. Duplicates are removed.

profiles.title: Creators (handles or profile URLs)
profiles.description: e.g. @penniestopounds or https://www.tiktok.com/@penniestopounds. Gets each creator's most recent videos (TikTok's public embed shows about the latest 10).

maxVideosPerProfile.title: Max videos per creator
maxVideosPerProfile.description: How many recent videos to transcribe per creator. TikTok's public embed exposes roughly the latest 10, so values above ~10 rarely add more.

captionLanguage.title: Caption language
captionLanguage.description: Leave empty (recommended) to get the original spoken-language transcript. Enter a language code such as 'en' or 'eng-US' to prefer TikTok's machine-translated caption track when it exists; otherwise the original is returned.

includeSegments.title: Include timed segments
includeSegments.description: Add a segments array: [{start, end, text}] in seconds.

includeSrt.title: Include SRT
includeSrt.description: Add an SRT subtitle string (ready for video editors and YouTube).

whisperFallback.title: Whisper fallback for videos without captions
whisperFallback.description: Off by default. When on, videos with no TikTok captions are downloaded and transcribed with Whisper (base model is built in). Charged as the higher-priced whisper-transcript event only when it returns speech. Slower than native captions; default 512 MB is fine for base, use 1 GB for small.

whisperModel.title: Whisper model
whisperModel.description: base (default, built in, fast) is good for clear speech. small is more accurate but slower and downloads at run start. tiny is fastest. Use 1 GB memory for small.

maxWhisperVideos.title: Max videos to Whisper
maxWhisperVideos.description: Safety cap: at most this many Whisper transcriptions per run.

whisperMaxDurationSecs.title: Max video length for Whisper (s)
whisperMaxDurationSecs.description: Skip Whisper for videos longer than this (seconds).

proxyMode.title: Network mode
enumTitles: Auto: direct first, proxy on retry (recommended)
proxyMode.description: Auto (recommended): direct request first, then retries via Apify Proxy with a fresh session if TikTok challenges or rate-limits. Residential proxy is not needed.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy used for retries. Apify datacenter proxy (default) is enough.

description: Paste TikTok video links and/or creator handles. You get the transcript (text, timed segments, SRT) in the video's original language, plus video and author metadata. Videos without captions are free; turn on Whisper to transcribe them too.
